closest_misses.file: LSU Tigers vs Nicholls Colonels at Tiger Stadium 09-07-2024 (28).jpg
closest_misses.why: A 100+ photo CC BY-SA 4.0 set from the upper deck (Sept 2024). The wide bowl frames (e.g. (28), (31)) are before sunset; every frame after dark is a telephoto crop of players, the sideline or the video board, never the lit bowl.
1024x680, a lit night bowl but small and pre-2014 (before the south end-zone upper deck).
4870x3233 CC BY-SA 2.0, night, but exterior (Mike the Tiger statue and the west facade), 2012.
1920x1080 CC BY-SA 4.0 drone shot, day not night; useful if a day aerial is ever wanted.
